title: FlatLands: Generative Floormap Completion From a Single Egocentric View
abstract: arXiv:2603.16016v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A single egocentric image typically captures only a small portion of the floor, yet a complete metric traversability map of the surroundings would better serve applications such as indoor navigation. We introduce FlatLands, a dataset and benchmark for single-view bird's-eye view (BEV) floor completion. The dataset contains 270,575 observations from 17,656 real metric indoor scenes drawn from six existing datasets, with aligned observation, visibility, validity, and ground-truth BEV maps, and the benchmark includes both in- and out-of-distribution evaluation protocols. We compare training-free approaches, deterministic models, ensembles, and stochastic generative models. Finally, we instantiate the task as an end-to-end monocular RGB-to-floormaps pipeline. FlatLands provides a rigorous testbed for uncertainty-aware indoor mapping and generative completion for embodied navigation.

translated_title: FlatLands：基于单张自我中心视角图像的生成式地面平面图补全
translated_abstract: 单张自我中心视角图像通常只能捕捉到地面的一小部分，而环境的完整度量可通行性地图能更好地服务于室内导航等应用。我们提出了FlatLands，一个用于单视角鸟瞰图（BEV）地面补全的数据集与基准。该数据集包含来自六个现有数据集中17,656个真实度量室内场景的270,575个观测样本，具有对齐的观测图像、可见性、有效性掩码和真值BEV地图，基准同时包括分布内和分布外评估协议。我们比较了免训练方法、确定性模型、集成模型和随机生成模型。最后，我们将该任务实例化为一个端到端的单目RGB到地面平面图的流水线。FlatLands为不确定性感知的室内建图以及面向具身导航的生成式补全提供了一个严格的测试平台。
tldr: 提出了FlatLands数据集与基准，利用27万余个真实室内场景观测实现从单张自我中心视角图像生成完整可通行的鸟瞰地面平面图，并系统比较了免训练、确定性、集成与随机生成等多种方法。
en_tdlr: FlatLands introduces a large-scale dataset and benchmark with over 270K observations from real indoor scenes for generative bird's-eye-view floormap completion from a single egocentric image, systematically comparing training-free, deterministic, ensemble, and stochastic generative approaches.
